localChanges: `generate-changelog.mjs` read external changes from the `yarn.lock` diff, and the renderer has resolved through `pnpm-lock.yaml` since b529bae — so every entry since would have listed no engine changes. It now compares the packages resolved at a commit and its parent, from whichever lockfile each has, and looks versions up by `v0.1.x` tag before bare `0.1.x`. A missing tag records the package without a log instead of stopping the run.

Local changes follow the format the release window already renders well: a one-change-per-line message keeps every line, and a subject-and-body message drops the subject and turns each body paragraph into a bullet, with trailers removed. Version-bump commits (`0.1.5`) are left out of external logs.

`--release` (`npm run release:changelog`) adds entries for every commit after the newest one, at the top of `releases.json`, without rewriting any existing entry. `generate-changelog-combined.sh` is retired: it rebuilt the file from scratch, which would delete the hand-written `0.0.0` entry and leave a trailing comma.

Checked against history before trusting it: regenerating 8a11546 reproduced the committed file byte for byte, and 4607766 matched in 32 of 34 packages — the other two are packages marked added, where the old walker kept capturing commits past the release. A trial over the 59 commits since added 59 entries with the existing 52 untouched and no missing tags.

`docs/build-and-release.md` now describes a release end to end: publish and resolve the engine, generate the changelog (it is bundled, so before the build), build on the commit being released, and deploy through civ-clone.github.io to civ.one.
